name: pulsar_showcase
description: The deterministic screenshot mode of the Cosmic Pulsar (CP 1919) 3D waterfall showcase.

checks.expectation: A dark, atmospheric portrait plot displaying a dense stack of horizontal ridges resembling the iconic pulsar radio waterfall, with a centered title and balanced horizontal margins.

A dense set of closely spaced ridges is layered vertically with clear depth and continuity. There should be no large missing sections, severe unintended merging, or clipping; minor visual overlap from perspective and antialiasing is acceptable.
The central emission corridor features jagged, multi-peak radio scintillation spikes that rise above the flat baseline wings.

The ridges show a clear Viridis-like progression from bright yellow near the top through green and teal/blue toward purple in the foreground. Normal backend-specific shade and interpolation differences are acceptable, but a missing, reversed, or substantially broken progression is not.
The ridge field is rendered smoothly with antialiasing, without clipped lines, large missing groups of curves, or corrupted regions, and text remains crisp.
The centered plot title and x-axis tick labels have crisp, legible glyph edges without clipping, blur, or raster corruption.
